clarification: These are commercial/product service tiers, NOT GCSE/IGCSE/A Level academic levels.

weekly.name: Grove Weekly
weekly.cadence: Four assigned 8-question weekly mixed-topic sets in each four-week block
weekly.student_goal: Build consistent exam technique and identify weaknesses.

ALL_ROUTES.topic_mix: Mixed-topic fluency, numerical reasoning, applied questions and worked evidence; difficulty adapts to student baseline and examiner feedback

weekly.assessment_workflow: Student answers 8 mixed-topic multiple-choice questions, showing working on whiteboard or photo; submitted work is released only after human examiner review.
weekly.calendaring: Automatically assigned on each student's weekly slot, anchored to their subscription start date; calendar checks approved unseen bank availability.
weekly.status: Live scheduler; mathematical coverage depends on qualification, board and approved original bank.

daily.name: Grove Daily
daily.cadence: Four short questions every day, PLUS four weekly 8-question mixed-topic sets per four-week cycle
daily.student_goal: Target specific errors and make mathematical working routine.

ALL_ROUTES.topic_mix: Daily focused transferable skills with evidence and tailored level; weekly includes several topics

daily.assessment_workflow: Daily short practice with mathematical working/photo; progress and feedback released by examiner; 8-question weekly work inherited from Grove Weekly.
daily.calendaring: Automatically assigns 28 daily sessions and four weekly sessions, no email notification. Calendar checks each pool independently for verified unseen questions.
daily.status: Live for routes with enough verified content; advanced-level question banks expanding.

exam.name: Grove Exam
exam.cadence: Six daily exam-preparation questions PLUS 8-question weekly sets PLUS one monthly 20-item timed practice mock.
exam.student_goal: Practice exam conditions and gather moderated evidence of readiness.

ALL_ROUTES.topic_mix: Tier-differentiated exam preparation; varied topics, adaptation from baseline and released examiner marks; carefully separated from full official-format papers

exam.assessment_workflow: 20-item original multiple-choice timed practice mock with server-side 90-minute lockout, whiteboard/photo evidence per question, private examiner review and release. This is NOT yet a moderated official-style multi-mark full exam paper.
exam.calendaring: Automatically assigns daily, weekly and an end-of-month 90-minute 20-item practice mock. No full-board format equivalence is claimed.
exam.status: Timed 20-item practice mock live; full board-authentic long-form mocks remain separate future work.

engine_description: Current system assigns auto-markable multiple-choice responses with whiteboard/photo evidence and separate examiner assessment of method and released comments. Practice items are worth one marking point each. These are NOT full official-board exam papers.
